requirements.requirement: Make the world alive and active
requirements.present: Regional packs, biome variation, champions, named elite guards, coordinated melee tactics. Repeatable three-wave wilderness expeditions, five oaths, wardens, safe waystone placement and earned cache choices. Expedition landmarks now show the chosen oath and cleared waves, open a physical coffer on a clear, and empty it when rewards are claimed; earned landmarks return after reload. A new three-seal ritual objective adds positioning and channel interruption to wilderness expeditions. Wardens now invoke telegraphed ground attacks tied to their oath. Spirit Relay adds a mobile collection and delivery encounter: three released spirits must reach lanterns while the warden keeps attacking. Two original Blender-authored species now join selected regional packs: Cairn Sentinel uses a breakable split carapace and committed three-part ground strike; Lantern Wraith circles and casts interruptible spectral volleys. Existing Stalfos charge bone darts and Wolfos rally nearby wolves. Native collision, shields, one-time defeat rewards, pause and scene cleanup pass integration tests. Counter guides and practice summons live in collapsed journal sections. Lantern Wraiths now prioritize wounded melee allies with a 44-tick braided healing tether. Each Wraith spends at most two attempts and each ally receives at most two heals across all casters. Hits/stuns, terrain, separation and defeat cancel the channel; native Wolfos support and active-channel scene cleanup are verified. Gohma now summons two marked, destructible brood pods during her native fight. New pointed cocoon meshes and terrain-fitted silk webs telegraph the fall; stunning Gohma cancels falling pods. Native weapons, Flame Burst and hammer fault lines break shells; utility hits delay incubation once. Ignored pods hatch into native larvae within a shared two-additional-brood cap. Boss defeat, toggles and scene transitions clean up added actors while preserving her original brood. 56 native checks pass, and production summon, slope rendering, native targeting, hatching and journal pause were visually verified.
requirements.remaining: Spontaneous world events and roaming activity; broader regional acceptance and additional objectives beyond gauntlet, ritual and relay.

requirements.requirement: Deep rares, uniques, sets, runeworks and gems
requirements.present: Rare modifier rolls; eight identified uniques, three four-piece sets, eight ordered runeworks, six gem families in three grades, six runes, socket extraction/salvage/upgrading and version-6 persistence. Four portable suites pass normally and sanitized; all 93 native gear/loot/enemy checks pass. Forge, equipment bonuses, set thresholds, gem upgrades and extraction verified through the native UI. Expedition caches now target an equipment slot, offer gem/rune alternatives, and guarantee unique/set quality every third depth. All twenty existing named gear pieces now retain distinct visual identity through socket changes; a temporary-adventure wardrobe lets testers equip and drop matching collections. Details separates set thresholds, unique powers, socket contents and runework powers. Three runtime powers span nine existing unique/full-set/runework sources: Furnace rhythm links techniques to basic-weapon recovery, Moonwell weave earns free offensive spells with basic hits, and Briar reprisal returns capped actual health loss after a guardian setup. Basic-weapon credit includes hammer, stick, bow and seeds; gear changes clear preparations and duplicate powers do not stack. Bow and hammer now have loot slots, weapon-local affixes and sockets, two more uniques and two more runeworks, bringing totals to ten uniques and ten runeworks. Targeted caches can reward either weapon.
requirements.remaining: Broaden rare roll diversity, expand build-defining item content and endgame reward targeting; repeated-run economy and combat balance.
